summary_cs: OpenCode je open-source (MIT) AI coding agent do terminálu: 75+ providerů (Claude/GPT/Gemini), přihlášení přes GitHub Copilot, lokální modely přes Ollamu, Tab = read-only Plan agent.
caption:
Paying for an AI coding app? There's a free, open-source one.

OpenCode is an open-source (MIT) AI coding agent for your terminal, with a desktop app in beta. Use Claude, GPT, Gemini or any of 75+ providers, log in with your GitHub Copilot plan, or run local models with Ollama. Press Tab for the read-only Plan agent. Paid models still cost what they cost; local ones are free.

Comment OPENCODE and I'll DM you the link.
